label: GOD_4 wills some GOOD_4 to every distinct intellectual being whose esse it causes
paraphrase: Open application bridge, analyst formulation, unattributed. For every GOD_4 g with will (HAS_WILL_1) and every x distinct from g, in act as to being and having intellect (HAS_INTELLECT_1), whose being g causes: there is a respect r in which x is good and g wills that good to x (recipient-directed willing, CREATURE_WILLING_1). The respect is existential. It says nothing about non-intellectual effects, about the divine self-case, about every good of x, about the degree or mode of willing, or that an act of willing efficiently causes x. It follows from 'Every GOD_4 wills some GOOD_4 to every being in act in esse' (c691e3d0) as sole premise, and from CausalExistenceWilling (a94c5dfc) with the q.5 a.1 coextension (00e962ae), without the self-case premise. Both verified supports go through a94c5dfc: c691e3d0's only derivation (argument 12865cf3) uses it. The premise itself is consistent with the strong (exclusive) ordered-love variant 1dd68893, an unattributed analyst strengthening of ad 3 (with rational read as having intellect), on a non-rational effect where CausalExistenceWilling fails (Control.Controls part 5); but a94c5dfc is incompatible with 1dd68893 on distinct non-rational caused effects, so if that strong variant holds and non-rational creatures exist, this premise has no verified derivation and stands only as a direct assumption. The conflict with a94c5dfc holds for that strong variant only; the weak, ad-3-faithful reading 7f6a2e91 (ordered willing without the exclusion of recipient-directed willing) is compatible with a94c5dfc (checked witness 5d93ac09), so under it both verified derivations of this premise stand. The natural-diffusion / foreseen-collateral alternative recorded for a94c5dfc still applies to intellectual effects: this restriction removes the non-rational conflict only.
